channels_sftp_settings.name: channels_sftp_settings
channels_sftp_settings.value: num_nonnulls("channels"."host", "channels"."port", "channels"."username", "channels"."remote_path", "channels"."authentication", "channels"."encrypted_credential") = case when "channels"."type" = 'sftp' then 6 else 0 end

channels_polling_interval.name: channels_polling_interval
channels_polling_interval.value: num_nonnulls("channels"."polling_interval_minutes") = case when "channels"."type" = 'sftp' and "channels"."direction" = 'inbound' then 1 else 0 end

channels_http_settings.name: channels_http_settings
channels_http_settings.value: num_nonnulls("channels"."url") = case when "channels"."type" = 'http' then 1 else 0 end

document_structures_format_settings.name: document_structures_format_settings
document_structures_format_settings.value: ("document_structures"."format" = 'json') = ("document_structures"."json_root" is not null) and ("document_structures"."format" = 'csv') = ("document_structures"."csv" is not null)

run_steps_timings.name: run_steps_timings
run_steps_timings.value:
case
        when "run_steps"."status" in ('pending', 'skipped') then num_nonnulls("run_steps"."started_at", "run_steps"."finished_at") = 0
        when "run_steps"."status" = 'running' then "run_steps"."started_at" is not null and "run_steps"."finished_at" is null
        else coalesce("run_steps"."started_at" <= "run_steps"."finished_at", false)
      end

runs_failure.name: runs_failure
runs_failure.value: num_nonnulls("runs"."failure_stage", "runs"."error", "runs"."problem") = case when "runs"."status" = 'failed' then 3 else 0 end

runs_output.name: runs_output
runs_output.value: "runs"."failure_stage" is null or "runs"."failure_stage" = 'delivery' or "runs"."output" is null
